comment: I thought Dr Kingsley was a great instructor. She wants her students to succeed and gives them the tools to do so. Her study guides were very helpful for exams as we as class reviews. I would recommend taking her class. The more you interact the better.

This is a really hard BIO101 course. Although nice, the professor is a terrible teacher. Lots of people failed tests in this class. Tests were extremely difficult, and the information wasn't covered in class sufficiently. Labs were also difficult and the professor herself couldn't answer the questions most times. I would recommend this class.

Reads word for word off of power points so when it comes to the test you have know idea what the question is asking. If you ask her a question she might be able to answer but most of the time she doesn't know the answer. Lab days can be confusing if you don't know the material. But she is nice and will try her best to teach.

She is a good teacher, when she has an idea of what she is doing. But if she has no idea what she is doing (happens on lab days when you are the first class in the morning). She doesn't know how to teach, relies a lot on her powerpoints, videos and pictures online. But she knows, the ppts, videos and pics are used as references.
